description: Aggregate public-health view based on SELECT * FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data. The panels intentionally expose counts only.

options.content:
# Public Health Dashboard

District disease tracker and patient-visit trends from the HIS-QA diagnosis dashboard data. Use the filters above and Grafana's time picker to explore the reporting period.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uhid_number)::bigint AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district_name)::bigint AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')

SELECT to_char(MAX(created_date), 'DD Mon YYYY HH24:MI') AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}')

SELECT district_name AS "District", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_communicable = 'Y')::bigint AS "Communicable Diseases", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_non_communicable = 'Y')::bigint AS "Non-communicable Diseases", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_notifiable = 'Y')::bigint AS "Notifiable Diseases", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_occupational_notifiable = 'Y')::bigint AS "Occupational Diseases", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vector_borne = 'Y')::bigint AS "Vector-borne Diseases" FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY district_name ORDER BY district_name

SELECT district_name AS "District", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(DAY FROM created_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 7)::bigint AS "1st Week", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(DAY FROM created_date) BETWEEN 8 AND 14)::bigint AS "2nd Week", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(DAY FROM created_date) BETWEEN 15 AND 21)::bigint AS "3rd Week", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(DAY FROM created_date) >= 22)::bigint AS "4th Week" FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY district_name ORDER BY district_name

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_date) AS time, diagnosis_desc AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE is_communicable = 'Y' AND $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_date) AS time, diagnosis_desc AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE is_non_communicable = 'Y' AND $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_date) AS time, diagnosis_desc AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE is_notifiable = 'Y' AND $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_date) AS time, diagnosis_desc AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE is_occupational_notifiable = 'Y' AND $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_date) AS time, diagnosis_desc AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE is_vector_borne = 'Y' AND $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_date) AS time, diagnosis_desc AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND ('${district}' = 'All' OR district_name = '${district}') AND ('${unit}' = 'All' OR unit_name = '${unit}') AND ('${year}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = '${year}') AND ('${month}' = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '${month}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
